lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
teamhub: 7 B beyond the first copy, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 7 B.
854,100 B in 7 pieces of 2 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (136 packages, 1,121 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in build is left without something that loads it.
